citation: 401 for an Authorization scheme the vendor does not accept (here: Basic) — RFC 9110 §15.5.2 + RFC 7235 §2.1 (auth-scheme token); module 06 §4.2/§4.3 (only Api-Key and Bearer are taught); { error, message } shape (§5.1).
notes: Auth ladder: recognized header, unrecognized scheme. <scheme> is echoed from the request.
